subject: Wish list: Mini-pie charts as scatterplot points

messages.author: 275d625bf64b327e
messages.subject: Wish list: Mini-pie charts as scatterplot points
parts:
I wonder if this already exists, or is worth doing. It would be great in conveying information about municipalities of a recognizably-shaped state or province, where latitude and longitude would place points on a plot, while pie-chart-points would give relative percentage information by town/city.

Brian

There was a project called ggsubplot which did just this sort of
thing. It was available on CRAN for a while but has been archived
for some time, unfortunately. See:
https://github.com/garrettgman/ggsubplot

I guess it should be achievable with grobs and annotation_custom.

Ron.
